Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Ιωάννης συγγραφέας της Κλίμακος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 30 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Преподобни Јован Лествичник“, with the rank word Преподобни left off, which is what this folder's `venerable` carries. Лествичник is kept: it is not a rank but the by-name the heading gives him, of the Ladder he wrote, and it is what this folder's English name already carries.

Read out of the calendar’s name link for 30 марта ст. ст., which gives «Преподобный Иоанн Лествичник»; Преподобный is the rank and is not part of the stored form. Лествичник is kept, as it is in this folder’s Serbian form and in its English name: it is not a rank but the by-name of the Ladder he wrote.

feast.note: His own fixed day, and the one all four churches now keep him on. His life pages give «Дни памяти: 9 марта , 30 марта», and the 9 марта of 2026 is the Fourth Sunday of Great Lent, which in that year fell on the civil 22 March: the reader of the Julian 03-09 met him on that page, read him as the moveable Sunday rather than as a fixed feast and deliberately wrote no row. The two days are twenty-one apart, not thirteen, so the difference is not the style conversion either. No moveable feast is held by this corpus and no `calendar: "paschal"` row exists in it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Иоанна Лествичника (649).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 30 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Ioan Scărarul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης συγγραφέας της Κλίμακος»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(523 - 606)» with both years hedged in its own prose — «γεννήθηκε πιθανότατα το 523 μ.Χ. στη Συρία», most probably, and «Εκοιμήθη εν ειρήνη περί το 606 μ.Χ.», about — and those hedges are why the `dates` added here are traditional and say probably and about. It names the relics: part of the skull at the monastery of the Great Meteoron, and portions at the monasteries of the Panagia of Damasta in Phthiotis and of the Panagia Tourliani on Mykonos. It names his teacher, the anchorite Martyrius, the four years of ascesis before his tonsure, his gift of wonderworking, his epithet the Sinaite, his abbacy of Sinai after the previous abbot's death and at the brethren's demand, and his return to the desert; and it names the two writings, «Κλίμακα» and «Λόγον προς τον Ποιμένα», and describes the thirty discourses. It prints two apolytikia and a kontakion; the first apolytikion is the proper and is added to this folder, the second is the common of an ascetic father, «Ταῖς τῶν δακρύων σου ῥοαῖς», and is not, and the kontakion's own text was cut off in the reading and is therefore not taken.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.04.2026 (30. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Јован Лествичник“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same man: the writer of the Ladder, who came to Mount Sinai as a boy of sixteen, was novice, then hermit, then abbot of Sinai, and whose biographer the monk Daniel is quoted here as he is on the Romanian page. **Two disagreements, both recorded here and neither resolved, because resolving either would be a reader's choice between sources.** First, the year: the entry has him abbot „до своје осамдесете године, када је и скончао око 563. године“ — to his eightieth year, when he died about 563 — where this folder holds a birth of probably 523 and a death of about 606 from saint.gr, which heads him «(523 - 606)». 563 falls outside that death and an eightieth year would put his birth near 483, outside that birth; the sourced interval **was not narrowed, widened or touched**, and the Prologue's reading stands beside it here and in the life. Second, the name of the elder who foretold his abbacy: the Prologue says Анастасије Синајски, Anastasius of Sinai, where the Romanian life already in this folder says «the great Athanasius of Sinai». No folder of either name exists in the corpus to decide it and neither reading was altered. New to the folder besides those: the nineteen years he spent in obedience to his spiritual father Martyrius, against saint.gr's four years before the tonsure; the twenty years in a cave after his elder's death, where the Romanian life has some forty years at Tholas; that the falling rock is what Moses was saved from, and that Moses heard John call him in his sleep and leapt up at that moment; and the year of complete silence he kept after some of the brethren reproached him as talkative, until they begged him to speak and go on teaching. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; this folder's two hymns are the Romanian's and the Greek's. The stored form Јован Лествичник keeps the epithet the heading gives it, Лествичник, the Ladder-writer, which is not a rank word: a bare Јован would fold with the five folders that already hold one.

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Ioan, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Ioan Scărarul

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren desert, and with sighs from the depths thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou becamest a light to the world, shining with miracles, O John our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Θεῖον κλίμακα, ὑποστηρίξας, τὴν τῶν λόγων σου, μέθοδον πάσι, Μοναστῶν ὑφηγητὴς ἀναδέδειξαι, ἐκ πρακτικῆς Ἰωάννη καθάρσεως, πρὸς θεωρίας ἀνάγων τὴν ἔλαμψιν. Πάτερ Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr — Άγιος Ιωάννης συγγραφέας της Κλίμακος, Ἀπολυτίκιον. Recorded with kind troparion, which is the schema's word for it. The page prints a second apolytikion after it, the common of an ascetic father, which is not taken.

english.text: Having set a divine ladder under the method of your words for all, you were shown forth as the instructor of monastics, O John, leading them up from the purification that is in practice to the radiance of contemplation. Venerable Father, entreat Christ God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Слез твоих теченьми пустыни безплодное возделал еси,/ и иже из глубины воздыханьми во сто трудов уплодоносил еси,/ и был еси светильник вселенней,/ сияя чудесы, Иоанне, отче наш,/ моли Христа Бога спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 марта ст. ст., «Тропарь преподобного Иоанна Лествичника, игумена Синайского», глас 8

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren wilderness, and with sighs out of the deep thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou wast a lamp to the whole world, shining with wonders, John our father: pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Яко Божественную лествицу, обретохом, Иоанне преподобне,/ твоя Божественныя добродетели,/ к Небеси возводящия ны:/ добродетелей бо ты был еси воображение./ Тем моли Христа Бога, да спасет души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 марта ст. ст., «Ин тропарь преподобного Иоанна Лествичника, игумена Синайского», глас 4

english.text: As a divine ladder we have found thy divine virtues, venerable John, which lead us up to heaven; for thou wast thyself the image of the virtues. Therefore pray to Christ God, that he may save our souls.

hymns.text: Плоды присноцветущия,/от твоей книги принося учения, премудре,/ услаждавши сердца, сим с трезвением внемлющих, блаженне:/ лествица бо есть, души возводящая от земли к Небесней и пребывающей славе/ верою чтущих тя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 марта ст. ст., «Кондак преподобного Иоанна Лествичника, игумена Синайского», глас 1. Copied as the page has it, including «услаждавши» for «услаждаеши» and the missing space after the first solidus.

english.text: Bringing from thy book the ever-blooming fruits of thy teaching, O most wise, thou dost sweeten the hearts of those who attend to them with sobriety, O blessed one; for it is a ladder that raises up from earth to the heavenly and abiding glory the souls of them that honour thee with faith.

hymns.text: На высоте Господь воздержания истинна тя положи,/ якоже звезду нелестную, световодящую концы,/ наставниче Иоанне, отче наш.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 марта ст. ст., «Ин кондак преподобного Иоанна Лествичника, игумена Синайского», глас 4

english.text: On the height the Lord set thee as a true man of abstinence, like a star that does not deceive, giving light to the ends of the earth, O John our teacher and father.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Ιωάννης της Κλίμακας γεννήθηκε πιθανότατα το 523 μ.Χ. στη Συρία», and the page heads him «(523 - 606)». The page's «πιθανότατα», most probably, is why the display says probably; this folder held no `dates` before.

death.note: saint.gr: «Εκοιμήθη εν ειρήνη περί το 606 μ.Χ. και άφησε δύο σπουδαιότατα συγγράμματα, την «Κλίμακα» και τον «Λόγον προς τον Ποιμένα»», and the page heads him «(523 - 606)». The page's «περί», about, is why the display says about 606.
